answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x in the primary region after a release that landed ~30 minutes before the climb, during settlement-peak writes. Rollback is the provisional choice because it historically cleared a checkout incident without dropping customer writes (b1) and does not fail closed. Regional-only symptoms also fit failover (b2), so those two records need source checks before commit; a write failover at settlement peak could lose or split customer writes. Circuit breaking would shed writes (violates the objective) and read-replica routing does not address the write path. Cause is still ambiguous among bad deploy, regional overload, and infra, so this stays a standard-scale rollback rather than a broad cutover.
